canonicalization.json: UTF-8 without BOM, exact Unicode scalar values without normalization; reject unpaired surrogates and duplicate parsed object keys. Sort JSON object keys lexicographically by Unicode scalar numeric value (not JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit order), recursively; no insignificant whitespace. JSON escapes only quote/backslash/U+0000..001F: use standard short escapes for backspace/tab/LF/formfeed/CR and lowercase \u00xx for the rest; leave all other scalars including U+2028/U+2029 unescaped. No ordinary JSON floating-point numbers. Canonical integer payload/byte-count strings exclude plus/leadingzero/-0; IEEE exact lowercase hex.
canonicalization.structure: Arrays retain order, map member keys exact; each tagged node includes kind and all required fields, additional fields rejected; duplicate parsed keys rejected.
canonicalization.digests: SHA256 over canonical full typed source node for sourceRootDigest; each sourceUnit hashes its scalar/reference payload or structural marker, scoped by snapshot+owner+pointer.
